title: Nylas grant.updated notification object
description: Sent when a grant is modified, updated, or re-authenticated. This schema describes `data.object` inside the Nylas notification envelope.

code.description: Nylas notification code. A value of `25014` indicates a normal update; `25027` indicates a re-authentication event.

integration_id.description: Identifier for the connector (integration) associated with this grant.

email.description: Email address associated with the grant.

reauthentication_flag.description: Whether this update was triggered by a re-authentication flow.

scope.description: Granted OAuth scopes. Only reliably present on `grant.created` events. For `grant.updated`, this field is typically absent.
